tools.name: evaluate_capability
tools.description: Decide whether a registry capability is worth buying for your task, from registry-run benchmarks only. Returns decision, expected effect, price, confidence, reasons, operator_message, next steps and an ak.offer.v1 offer (status, next_action, economics, the four evidence kinds listed apart). Give mod

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Lexical search over capability names, summaries, tasks and use-when conditions. Ranking is by relevance only, never by payment.

tools.name: compare_capabilities
tools.description: Assess 2-5 capabilities side by side for the same inputs, with the same method and ak.offer.v1 offer shape as evaluate_capability.

tools.name: estimate_roi
tools.description: Per measured model: expected saving per run, break-even runs and net saving over expected_runs, with intervals.

tools.name: get_capability
tools.description: The capability's card: purpose, use-when and do-not-use-when conditions, permissions, price, evidence summary, trust checks, links and a task-independent ak.offer.v1 offer.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: Registry-run benchmark summaries (labelled), publisher claims (labelled PUBLISHER CLAIMED) and the signed attestations.

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: Artifact hash, manifest hash, signed publisher and registry attestations and a transparency-log inclusion proof.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: A signed 15-minute price quote with the hosted checkout link. It charges nothing; a purchase requires operator approval in the hosted checkout.

tools.name: unlock_capability
tools.description: Exchange the license key from the checkout (a purchase requires operator approval) for a signed entitlement and a download link that lasts at most 15 minutes. How the key is handled: the privacy page at /legal/privacy/. Repeating it with the same key is safe and never charges.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report how a capability worked for you. Stored as AGENT REPORTED; it never changes evidence labels, trust or ranking. Only the listed fields are accepted; no task text is kept.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "evaluate_capability" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: task, capability, model, expected_runs, baseline_cost_estimate_usd, context, constraints, budget_policy
